last_result.headline: Q56 smoke PASSED all three gate conditions -- the first positive 3-well 5th percentile in this rotation (+0.0836, P(>0) 0.9944), nested +0.6050 at blend level, helps 91.7% of wells. The deployed PF is a single forward pass, so every toe row but the last is estimated from less information than we hold; textbook FFBSi is degenerate under this near-deterministic transition, so the ancestral-path smoother was implemented instead. The trellis twin is derived from the deployed source by four anchored insertions and verified byte-for-byte against the untouched deployed function; path degeneracy was measured before scoring and does NOT collapse (ancestor ESS ~12 at 599 rows of lookahead); the truth-column audit is clean. Two monotonicities (in alpha and in lookahead dose) plus a Savitzky-Golay control showing denoising is only ~8% of the gain point to a real mechanism rather than an artifact. The 760-well NS=32 run is in flight with ETA ~2 h; the smoke wells are easier than average so nothing is concluded yet. No submission -- can_submit=false.
